identified_issues: Chronology laundering through synthetic backdating of execution timestamps
Direct mutation of immutable historical audit records violating temporal non-retroactivity
Falsification of pre-trade risk compliance status where verification occurred post-trade
Epistemic violation under Temporal Custodian jurisdiction by collapsing t3 evaluation into pre-t1 state
evidence: Order ORD_99182 was initiated at t1 = 10:00:00.100 and filled at t2 = 10:00:00.120 prior to risk verification
Risk engine evaluation occurred post-trade at t3 = 10:00:00.250 with evaluated_at recorded as 10:00:00.250
Compliance reporting script executed SQL UPDATE on trade_audit_ledger mutating risk_verified_at to 10:00:00.095 and setting compliance_verdict to PRE_TRADE_APPROVED
Reporting script submitted official filing falsely claiming order was pre-trade risk-approved at 10:00:00.095
recommended_action: Enforce an append-only, immutable schema for trade_audit_ledger to prevent retroactive state mutations. Restore order ORD_99182 to its authentic historical record reflecting post-trade evaluation at 10:00:00.250. Strip database UPDATE privileges from automated compliance scripts, implement cryptographic digest chaining for audit events, and report the backdating incident for governance remediation.
